subject: Request: employee evidence package and deprovisioning logs for SOC2 review
messages:
From: Caroline Barnes <caroline@epochhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — employee screening, training, and leaver controls

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. Our compliance team is moving ahead with the SOC 2 readiness checklist and has a couple of specific asks around personnel controls. Can you provide a small evidence package that demonstrates:

- redacted background check confirmations for a set of ~10 hires (hash or unique ID ok; remove PII such as SSN)
- training completion records for security and privacy (date + course identifier) for the same cohort
- an example deprovisioning export showing last-login + account disabled timestamps for a terminated user

We don't need full raw documents—redacted PDFs and CSV exports are fine. If you can include the retention policy reference and the name of the HR system that generated the artifacts, that will speed review.

Can you get this to us by end of day PDT? If not, let us know a realistic ETA.

Cheers,
Caroline
Caroline Barnes
Head of Security Programs, EpochHealth
caroline@epochhealth.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request — employee screening, training, and leaver controls

Jonas / Marissa — forwarding a SOC2 evidence ask from a prospect (EpochHealth). They want a small sample bundle demonstrating background-check redaction, training completion, and a deprovisioning export for a terminated account.

Jonas: can you pull a redacted batch from our HR exports (hash employee IDs, remove SSNs) and include the deprovisioning audit export (last-login / disabled_at)?
Marissa: please pull training completion rows for the same cohort from the LMS and confirm course IDs (sec101, privacy101) and completion timestamps.

Notes / constraints:
- Use hashed employee IDs, no PII in PDFs.
- Add a one-line provenance note in each file: source system and export timestamp (e.g., BambooHR export, LMS export, logs from IAM).
- Redaction checklist: full name -> initials only, DOB -> year only, SSN removed.

I won't be able to review redactions deeply before we send; keep the sample small (8–12 users). We should include a short readme (text) that explains the columns and redaction approach.

Target timeline: deliver draft package to me by 12:30pm PDT so I can sanity-check before we send to Epoch.

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request — Evidence package (draft attached)

Sofia — attached draft artifacts: redacted-backgrounds-sample-epoch.pdf (10 records), training-completion-log-2027.csv, deprovisioning-audit-export-202703.json. Highlights:

- Backgrounds: removed SSNs; names reduced to initials; DOB replaced with birth year. Source = HR export (BambooHR) pulled 2028-03-15T10:45:00Z.
- Training: LMS export (LearningHub) with course IDs and completion timestamps; user IDs hashed with sha256-salt; included course sec101 + privacy101.
- Deprovisioning: IAM audit export with last_login_at and disabled_at fields for a terminated user (user id hashed).

Question: Epoch asked for retention policy reference — we can include the current policy section (Personnel Records retention — 7 years) but redacted policy PDF lives in internal Confluence. Do you want me to attach an exported PDF snippet or a link?

Attaching drafts now for redaction review.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Barnes <caroline@epochhealth.com>, audits@thirdparty-audit.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — employee evidence package and deprovisioning logs for SOC2 review

Caroline,

Thanks for the request and patience — attaching a small evidence bundle that addresses the items you listed. Attachments (redacted):
- redacted-backgrounds-sample-epoch.pdf (10 anonymized background-check confirmations; PII removed per our redaction checklist)
- training-completion-log-2027.csv (export from LearningHub; includes course id and completion timestamp)
- deprovisioning-audit-export-202703.json (IAM audit export with last_login_at and disabled_at for a terminated user)

We've also included a brief readme in the PDF cover page describing source systems and export timestamps. For retention policy, see the excerpt included in the cover page: Personnel Records retention = 7 years (HR policy internal). If you prefer an external copy, we can produce a PDF excerpt suitable for audit consumption.

Drive link (read-only, expires 14 days): https://drive.redwood.com/s/epoch-evidence/abc123 (attachments are also attached to this email).

Let us know if you need additional detail (e.g., chain-of-custody for background vendor, redaction proof). Happy to arrange a short call with Jonas and our HR lead.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
